It leaves an empty, usable ledger so a load can follow, and it is how the grader returns to a known state.\n\n## Behavior\n\n- Takes no arguments. Any argument is a usage error, exit 2.\n- When the database location is the default `data/app.db`, creates its parent directory if missing.\n- Opens the store through `ledger_app.store.open_store`, which provisions the declared tables idempotently.\n- Deletes all transactions first, then categories, then accounts, so references never dangle.\n- Writes nothing to standard output and exits 0. A rerun on an empty or populated ledger behaves the same.\n- If the store cannot be opened, exits 1 with one stderr line and no stdout.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-TRANSACTIONS-006` — write: remove every transaction - supplies: `floor_id`\n- `FEATURE-CATEGORIES-004` — write: remove every category - supplies: `floor_code`\n- `FEATURE-ACCOUNTS-006` — write: remove every account - supplies: `floor_code`\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC init-exit-and-stdout ===\nIntent: Init exits 0 and writes nothing to standard output.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\ncode, out, err = cli_runner(\"init\")\nprint(out)\nprint(err)\nassert code == 0\nassert out == \"\"\n=== END AC init-exit-and-stdout ===\n\n=== AC init-removes-rows ===\nIntent: Init removes existing transactions, categories, and accounts, verified by reading the store back.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nacct = \"ZZIN001\"\ncat = \"ZZIN001\"\ntid = 900002001\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Init Account\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Init Category\")\n    db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=tid, date=\"2026-04-01\", account=acct, category=cat, amount=100, memo=\"\"\n    )\n    assert db.transactions.get(txn_id=tid) is not None\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"init\")\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    assert db.transactions.get(txn_id=tid) is None\n    assert db.categories.get(category=cat) is None\n    assert db.accounts.get(account=acct) is None\n    assert db.accounts.list() == []\n    assert db.categories.list() == []\n    assert db.transactions.list() == []\n=== END AC init-removes-rows ===\n\n=== AC init-idempotent ===\nIntent: Running init twice in a row succeeds both times and leaves the store empty.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nfirst = cli_runner(\"init\")\nsecond = cli_runner(\"init\")\nassert first[0] == 0\nassert second[0] == 0\nassert second[1] == \"\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    assert db.accounts.list() == []\n    assert db.categories.list() == []\n    assert db.transactions.list() == []\n=== END AC init-idempotent ===\n\n=== AC init-store-usable ===\nIntent: After init the tables accept new rows that read back unchanged.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ndef f(r, k):\n    return r[k] if isinstance(r, dict) else getattr(r, k)\n\nacct = \"ZZIN002\"\nname = \"After Init\"\ncode, out, err = cli_runner(\"init\")\nassert code == 0\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=name)\n    got = db.accounts.get(account=acct)\n    assert got is not None\n    assert f(got, \"name\") == name\n=== END AC init-store-usable ===\n\n=== AC init-rejects-arguments ===\nIntent: Init with an extra argument is a usage error with exit 2 and no standard output.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\ncode, out, err = cli_runner(\"init\", \"extra\")\nprint(err)\nassert code == 2\nassert out == \"\"\n=== END AC init-rejects-arguments ===\n\n## User Acceptance\n\n- None.\n\n## Guardrails\n\n- Init is the only command that prepares storage; other commands never create tables.\n- Init writes nothing to standard output on success or failure.\n- Application code reaches the store only through `ledger_app.store.open_store` and the generated persistence package.\n=== END ARTIFACT ===\n=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-Count.md ===\n# FEATURE: Count\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Version | 20261026 V1 |\n| Description | The `ledger count` command reports the number of stored rows in each table. |\n| Depends On | DATABASE.md, FEATURE-StoreAccess.md, FEATURE-CsvOutput.md, FEATURE-Init.md |\n| Provides | ledger count |\n| Consumes | cli.output.write_table, ledger_app.store.open_store |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nLets the operator and the grader confirm what the ledger holds across separate invocations.\n\n## Behavior\n\n- Takes no arguments; any argument is a usage error, exit 2.\n- Writes the header `table,rows`, then one row each for `accounts`, `categories`, and `transactions`, in that order.\n- Each count is the number of rows returned by the table's list operation, so it always reflects stored data.\n- Output is written as the final act of the handler.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-ACCOUNTS-002` — read: list accounts to count them - returns: `account`\n- `FEATURE-CATEGORIES-002` — read: list categories to count them - returns: `category`\n- `FEATURE-TRANSACTIONS-002` — read: list all transactions to count them - returns: `txn_id`\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC count-reports-stored-rows ===\nIntent: Count reports the row counts of the stored data under the expected header.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nacct_codes = [\"ZZCN001\", \"ZZCN002\"]\ncat_code = \"ZZCN001\"\ntxn_ids = [1, 2, 3]\ncode, out, err = cli_runner(\"init\")\nassert code == 0\nwith db_session() as db:\n    for c in acct_codes:\n        db.accounts.create(account=c, name=\"Count \" + c)\n    db.categories.create(category=cat_code, description=\"Count Category\")\n    for i in txn_ids:\n        db.transactions.create(\n            txn_id=i, date=\"2026-04-01\", account=acct_codes[0], category=cat_code,\n            amount=100, memo=\"\"\n        )\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"count\")\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    expected = [\n        [\"table\", \"rows\"],\n        [\"accounts\", str(len(acct_codes))],\n        [\"categories\", \"1\"],\n        [\"transactions\", str(len(txn_ids))],\n    ]\n    assert rows == expected\n=== END AC count-reports-stored-rows ===\n\n=== AC count-empty-ledger ===\nIntent: After init every count is zero, matching what the store holds.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ncode, out, err = cli_runner(\"init\")\nassert code == 0\nwith db_session() as db:\n    held = [len(db.accounts.list()), len(db.categories.list()), len(db.transactions.list())]\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"count\")\n    assert code == 0\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    assert [r[0] for r in rows[1:]] == [\"accounts\", \"categories\", \"transactions\"]\n    assert [int(r[1]) for r in rows[1:]] == held\n    assert held == [0, 0, 0]\n=== END AC count-empty-ledger ===\n\n=== AC count-row-order ===\nIntent: Count lists the tables in the specified order with a two-column shape on every row.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\ncode, out, err = cli_runner(\"init\")\nassert code == 0\ncode, out, err = cli_runner(\"count\")\nassert code == 0\nrows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\nassert rows[0] == [\"table\", \"rows\"]\nassert [r[0] for r in rows[1:]] == [\"accounts\", \"categories\", \"transactions\"]\nassert all(len(r) == 2 for r in rows)\n=== END AC count-row-order ===\n\n=== AC count-rejects-arguments ===\nIntent: Count with an extra argument is a usage error with exit 2 and no standard output.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\ncode, out, err = cli_runner(\"count\", \"extra\")\nprint(err)\nassert code == 2\nassert out == \"\"\n=== END AC count-rejects-arguments ===\n\n## User Acceptance\n\n- None.\n\n## Guardrails\n\n- Counts are read from stored rows; no count is hardcoded.\n- Count never writes to the store.\n=== END ARTIFACT ===\n=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-LoadAccounts.md ===\n# FEATURE: Load Accounts\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Version | 20261026 V1 |\n| Description | The `ledger load accounts` command stores accounts from a CSV file all-or-nothing and defines the shared strict CSV reader. |\n| Depends On | DATABASE.md, FEATURE-Init.md, FEATURE-TextValidation.md, FEATURE-CsvOutput.md, FEATURE-StoreAccess.md |\n| Provides | ledger load accounts, ledger_app.csv_input.read_rows |\n| Consumes | ledger_app.validation.code, ledger_app.validation.name, cli.output.write_table |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nBulk-loads accounts from a file whose header is `account,name`. It also delivers `read_rows`, the strict reader every load command uses.\n\n## Behavior\n\n- Arguments: `<csv>`. A wrong argument count is a usage error, exit 2.\n- `read_rows(path, header)` parses with the `csv` module. The header must equal the expected columns exactly. A header mismatch, an empty file, a blank line, or a row whose field count differs from the header is Rejected, exit 3. An unreadable or missing file is an operational failure, exit 1.\n- Every row's code and name are validated with the shared text validators. A name containing a comma (only possible through quoting) is rejected.\n- Duplicate codes inside the file, and codes already stored, are Rejected, exit 3.\n- Only after every check passes are all rows stored. A rejected load stores none of its rows.\n- Writes `table,loaded` then `accounts,<N>`, where N is the number of rows stored.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-ACCOUNTS-001` — read: look up a code to detect an existing account - supplies: `account` - returns: `account`\n- `FEATURE-ACCOUNTS-003` — write: store one account per file row - supplies: `account`, `name` - returns: `account`, `name`\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC load-accounts-success ===\nIntent: Loading a valid accounts file stores every row and reports the loaded count.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ndef f(r, k):\n    return r[k] if isinstance(r, dict) else getattr(r, k)\n\ndata = [[\"ZZLA001\", \"First Account\"], [\"ZZLA002\", \"Second Account\"]]\ncode, out, err = cli_runner(\"init\")\nassert code == 0\nwith tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n    path = os.path.join(d, \"accounts.csv\")\n    with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as fh:\n        w = csv.writer(fh, lineterminator=\"\\n\")\n        w.writerow([\"account\", \"name\"])\n        w.writerows(data)\n    with db_session() as db:\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"accounts\", path)\n        print(out)\n        print(err)\n        assert code == 0\n        parsed = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n        assert parsed == [[\"table\", \"loaded\"], [\"accounts\", str(len(data))]]\n        for c, n in data:\n            got = db.accounts.get(account=c)\n            assert got is not None\n            assert f(got, \"name\") == n\n=== END AC load-accounts-success ===\n\n=== AC load-accounts-header-mismatch ===\nIntent: A file whose header differs from account,name is rejected with exit 3 and stores nothing.\n\nimport csv\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ncode, out, err = cli_runner(\"init\")\nassert code == 0\nwith tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n    path = os.path.join(d, \"accounts.csv\")\n    with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as fh:\n        w = csv.writer(fh, lineterminator=\"\\n\")\n        w.writerow([\"code\", \"name\"])\n        w.writerow([\"ZZLA003\", \"Wrong Header\"])\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"accounts\", path)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    with db_session() as db:\n        assert db.accounts.get(account=\"ZZLA003\") is None\n=== END AC load-accounts-header-mismatch ===\n\n=== AC load-accounts-atomic-on-bad-row ===\nIntent: One invalid row rejects the whole file, so earlier valid rows are not stored.\n\nimport csv\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ngood = [\"ZZLA004\", \"Good Row\"]\nbad = [\"not valid\", \"Bad Code Row\"]\ncode, out, err = cli_runner(\"init\")\nassert code == 0\nwith tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n    path = os.path.join(d, \"accounts.csv\")\n    with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as fh:\n        w = csv.writer(fh, lineterminator=\"\\n\")\n        w.writerow([\"account\", \"name\"])\n        w.writerow(good)\n        w.writerow(bad)\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"accounts\", path)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 3\n    assert load-accounts-invalid-fields ===\nIntent: Over-long names, names containing a comma, and over-long codes are each rejected with exit 3.\n\nimport csv\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom cli.testing \"\"],\n]\ncode, out, err = cli_runner(\"init\")\nassert code == 0\nwith tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n    for i, row in enumerate(cases):\n        path = os.path.join(d, \"accounts%d.csv\" % code, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"accounts\", path)\n        print(err)\n        assert code == 3\n        assert out == \"\"\n    with db_session() as db:\n        assert db.accounts.list() == csv\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ndup = \"ZZLA006\"\ncode, out, err = cli_runner(\"init\")\nassert code == 0\nwith tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n    path = os.path.join(d, \"accounts.csv\")\n    with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as fh:\n        w = csv.writer(fh, lineterminator=\"\\n\")\n        w.writerow([\"account\", \"name\"])\n        w.writerow([dup, \"One\"])\n        w.writerow([dup, \"Two\"])\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"accounts\", path)\n    print(err)\n    assert \"ZZLA008\"\ncode, out, err = cli_runner(\"init\")\nassert code == 0\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=stored, name=original)\n    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\n`ledger init` is the only command that prepares storage. A rerun on an empty or populated ledger behaves the same.\n- If the store cannot be opened, exits 1 with one stderr line and no stdout.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-TRANSACTIONS-006` — write: remove every transaction - supplies: `floor_id`\n- `FEATURE-CATEGORIES-004` — write: remove every category - supplies: `floor_code`\n- `FEATURE-ACCOUNTS-006` — write: remove every account - cli_runner(\"init\")\nassert code == 0\nwith tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n    path = os.path.join(d, \"wrong.csv\")\n    with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as fh:\n        w = csv.writer(fh, lineterminator=\"\\n\")\n        w.writerow([\"id\", \"date\", \"account\", \"category\", \"amount\", \"memo\"])\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"transactions\", path)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"transactions\", os.path.join(d, \"absent.csv\"))\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 1\n    assert out == \"\"\ncode, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"transactions\")\nprint(err)\nassert code == 2\nassert out == \"\"\n=== END AC load-txn-header-arity-and-file ===\n\n=== AC load-txn-seed-files ===\nIntent: The staged seed transactions load completely after accounts and categories, and the rejected seed file stores nothing.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ndef f(r, k):\n    return r[k] if isinstance(r, dict) else getattr(r, k)\n\ngood = \"sources/seed_transactions.csv\"\nbad = \"sources/seed_transactions_bad.csv\"\nwith open(good, newline=\"\") as fh:\n    good_rows = list(csv.reader(fh))[1:]\ncode, out, err = cli_runner(\"init\")\nassert code == 0\nassert cli_runner(\"load\", \"accounts\", \"sources/seed_accounts.csv\")[0] == 0\nassert cli_runner(\"load\", \"categories\", \"sources/seed_categories.csv\")[0] == 0\nwith db_session() as db:\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"transactions\", bad)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert db.transactions.list() == []\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"transactions\", good)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    parsed = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    assert parsed == [[\"table\", \"loaded\"], [\"transactions\", str(len(good_rows))]]\n    stored = db.transactions.list()\n    assert len(stored) == len(good_rows)\n    assert [f(r, \"txn_id\") for r in stored] == sorted(int(r[0]) for r in good_rows)\n    totals = {}\n    for r in stored:\n        totals[f(r, \"account\")] = totals.get(f(r, \"account\"), 0) + f(r, \"amount\")\n    assert all(v >= 0 for v in totals.values())\n=== END AC load-txn-seed-files
